entries.original: Senpi: omo now names any senpi feature it relies on that the running senpi lacks in one startup warning, and opening a monitor on another device's session on a senpi without remote wake fails with `remote_wake_unavailable` instead of starting a watch that never wakes. A contract test checks every such feature against the pinned senpi. ([#12862](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12862), fixes [#12861](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/12861))

The browser skill now depends on the published `omowright` package (`^0.3.0`, the first release that ships a built `dist/` that loads under Node as well as Bun) instead of a git commit. Its runtime stager and loader accept omowright's TypeScript sources, the older JavaScript sources, or a compiled `dist/`, in that order, so a future layout change cannot silently break the staged browser runtime (#12842, #12851, #12847). ([#12847](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12847))

entries.original: Memory facts extraction records facts again with senpi 2026.11.6-3: the facts child (also used by onboarding's understand step) keeps the approval mode its own settings give it and may run only its own record tools without asking, instead of being refused as a child whose parent is gone. ([#12839](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12839))

Concurrent memory account resolves on a desktop host share one open, so the app sees one `descriptor` request instead of one per caller; a failed open is retried by the next resolve (carried from #12717, which this PR supersedes). ([#12839](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12839))

Thread tools: an agent can now reach a session on another device of the same account by its name. A name that matches the title of one live session on another device sends there, and a name shared across devices (or with a thread on this device) is refused as ambiguous with every candidate and its device listed, never picked silently. Claiming or renaming a thread alias on a signed-in CLI device now reaches the account's alias registry instead of always answering that the registry cannot be reached; an alias claimed on one device now reaches that thread from every other device instead of reporting its device offline, and a registry outage never changes how a plain name resolves. `omo thread read` resolves aliases and other devices' threads the way the agent's `thread_read` does. ([#12837](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12837), fixes [#12833](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/12833))

Release: the service-auth release step now refuses a bundle that carries more than one release key set, so it always checks the set the bundle ships. ([#12812](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12812), fixes [#12617](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/12617))

Runtime fallback: when a session times out and no fallback model can be prepared, the user is now warned even if nothing was awaiting a fallback, the warning names the real reason ("no available fallback models" while attempts remain, instead of "max fallback attempts reached"), and a compaction that outlives its watchdog budget returns control as a real cancellation without staying marked as recovering. ([#12790](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12790), fixes [#12762](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/12762))

Standalone binary on Windows: running the provisioned runtime copy directly (`~/.omo/binary-runtime/<version>/omo.exe`) no longer hands off to itself and reports itself as the installed launcher when the home path is spelled with an 8.3 short name or different letter case. ([#12772](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12772), fixes [#12769](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/12769))

entries.original: When a dream or reflection run deletes, archives or moves a memory note, `[[path]]` and relative markdown links to it in other notes are now updated in the same run, after the completion check has decided which of the run's changes land. A moved note's links follow it, and the moved note's own relative links keep pointing at their targets. A note the run archived, meaning its `ARCHIVE.md` entry names the file (its path, or its file name when no other note shares it), is linked as `[[ARCHIVE.md|<old path> (archived)]]`. Links to any other removed note, such as one the user asked to forget, become plain text. A note the completion check refuses, or one whose rewrite it would refuse (for example a note that already holds secret-like text), or one that is not valid UTF-8, keeps its links as they were, so `/doctor` can still report those. A targeted `/dream --to <doc>` that removes its own target is no longer refused because of these link updates. Facts extraction also no longer writes into a month ledger path that was archived or deleted: that month's new facts go to `notes/facts/<month>-2.md` (then `-3`, ...), so an old link can never start pointing at unrelated new content. ([#12642](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/12642)) ([#12645](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12645))

entries.original: Runtime fallback keeps compaction retries separate from the primary model chain and preserves substantive retry prompts. Compaction watchdogs defer within a bounded budget, exhausted native retry signals do not trigger an abort, and stuck-session watchdogs still return control when no replacement can be dispatched. Thanks @mradwankhalil. ([#11907](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11907), fixes [#9786](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9786))

entries.original: Background tasks let runtime fallback decide who recovers a session error before starting a replacement or finalizing the task. Exhausted and refused retries release recovery ownership, model-less retry errors can finish the task, and a slow decision never starts a competing replacement. ([#9683](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9683), [#11907](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11907))

entries.original: Task children ask through the parent session instead of being refused: a child's permission prompt (and its other select, confirm, input and editor dialogs) is raised on the parent's UI, so Allow runs the child's call and Deny does not. A child the parent turn is waiting on asks on the connection that started that turn; a background child asks every attached client that may answer. Secret inputs and permanent grant selections are never forwarded. Children in their own process or on the task host open in the parent's approval mode and follow every later change of it, one change at a time and always ending on the latest; a child that could not follow is reported to the parent session. ([#12839](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12839))

entries.original: The compiled engine no longer has the unused `installEngineCaTrust` startup routine. That routine set `NODE_USE_SYSTEM_CA=1` but had no caller, and engine launches set up certificate trust in the launcher trust stage. A new test checks that an engine started without `NODE_USE_SYSTEM_CA` in its environment does not get it from the launcher. Validation of `OMO_EXTRA_CA_CERTIFICATES` is unchanged. ([#12628](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12628), part of #10762)
